items.description: Disposal of shed roof timber and broken glass
items.rationale: The tree impact is covered under 2.5.3(c), and both materials are insured shed debris under 5.2.1(a), so the combined line qualifies under 7.1.10. Using Case 8, allow €65 for timber and €32 for glass, for €97 gross.

items.description: Mixed green waste, oversized root mass and soil
items.rationale: Section 5.2.1 excludes the root mass over 1 m³ and the excavated soil, and the work does not qualify as reinstatement-related ground works under 5.2.2. Section 7.1.10 therefore bars the whole line without carving out the green waste; €240 is a conditional gross estimate only.
Paving grit is ground material excluded from debris clearance under 5.2.1(d), and standalone disposal does not meet 5.2.2. The €28 gross estimate is conditional only.
Screening does not change topsoil’s exclusion as ground material under 5.2.1(d), and there was no qualifying ground reinstatement under 5.2.2. The €30 gross estimate is conditional only.
